# h3_vpc (Data Source)

Looks up a VPC by `id`, or by `project_id` (and `name` when the project has several VPCs). The project VPC has the project ID as its ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The VPC of the provider's default project.
data "h3_vpc" "main" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) VPC ID
- `name` (String) VPC name
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID); the provider default when omitted

### Read-Only

- `namespaces` (List of String) Namespaces attached to the VPC
- `status` (String) VPC status
